result.summary: The food-delivery home screen is generally clean and usable. The only notable visual break is a restaurant name truncated by the edge of a carousel card; other edge clipping matches expected horizontal-scroll and viewport-cutoff behavior.

issues.description: In the Fastest near you row, the third restaurant name is cut off as “Trattoria Piccol” instead of showing the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a slightly smaller type size, or add an ellipsis so the name is clearly truncated rather than abruptly clipped.
